Reasoning: The problem gives X = 1, and the selection input S1S0 = 11. For a 1-to-4 DEMUX, the selection codes 00, 01, 10, 11 usually select outputs P0, P1, P2, P3 respectively. Therefore when S1S0 = 11, P3 is selected and receives the data input X, so P3 = X = 1.
